name: Wuxing Pikemen
headerMeta: Silver era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 155 leadership · Honor Tree, Mastery
pitch: A mastery-driven pike unit that strips defences off the tankiest targets on the field before finishing with Wuxing Blast. Its Fiery Blast rework (radius +20%, now instant) landed after Amya's guide was last updated, so engage timing here is pre-patch and due a refresh.

controls.notes: X-move to close, press 2 (Fiery Blast — now instant activation {3}) and let the animation play out, then press 1 (Wuxing Blast finisher). {1} House combo: land skill 2 in the blob to strip ~200 defence plus a burn tick, then finish with Wuxing Blast. {2}
